title: How can I remove the auto-tile shadows in MZ?

posts.author: snakes_
posts.body: This is basically impossible to google because all the results are for older RPG Maker versions. But does anyone have a solution for how to remove the automatically-generated tile shadows that MZ creates? It's ruining my map, and there are so many that removing them manually is not an option at this point. I appreciate any help. Thanks!

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
Well, the tool mentioned above would be the obvious answer, but you mentioned it is too many to do manually.
In the DLC folder for MV, there is a tiny plugin that would remove all auto-shadows instantly. Perfect! It might work on MZ too. If you have MV, it sould be in your DLC folder by default, otherwise I have no idea where to find it.
It is called No Autoshadow and was written by Archeia (Yes, the archeia, that is also mod on this forum)
